parallels.note: The priest shall offer one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, because…
The priest shall present them before Yahweh, and shall offer his sin offering and his burnt offering.

translations.web: The priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh for his discharge.
translations.bsb: The priest is to sacrifice them, one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for the man before the LORD because of his discharge.
translations.kjv: And the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD for his issue.
translations.asv: and the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him before Jehovah for his issue.
